name: smwsprites-mosaic-thwimp
title: Mosaic Thwimp
description:
Thwimp that goes right/left or up/down until it hits a wall, and then turns around.

Customizable with the defines.

Named after one of my favorite enemies from Vista Quest, "Mosaic".

I submitted this because "I might as well". It's a pretty simple sprite, but it may be useful for level design.

Now SA-1 hybrid.
